name: Kaai 4 Braai Restaurant
description: An authentic South African braai (BBQ) experience right on the water's edge. Enjoy traditional dishes, meat straight off the fire, and a laid-back sandy floor atmosphere.

name: Delfino's Restaurant
description: Iconic seaside dining at The Point. Famous for their fantastic pizzas, fresh seafood, and sweeping ocean views where you can often spot dolphins.

name: Blue Shed Coffee Roastery
description: A quirky, vintage-styled coffee shop offering artisan roasted coffee, fresh baked goods, and a cozy atmosphere perfect for morning relaxations.

name: Baruch's Coffee Roastery
description: Authentic Israeli-style coffee roastery and bakery. Known for their incredible middle-eastern inspired breakfasts, fresh bagels, and premium coffee blends.

name: Sea Gypsy Cafe
description: A rustic, legendary seafood spot right on the harbour edge. Famous for their massive seafood platters, casual vibe, and views of the boats coming and going.

name: Cafe Gannet
description: Known as Mossel Bay's seafood house, offering a slightly more upscale dining experience. Excellent oysters, fresh line fish, and a beautiful outdoor seating area.

name: Big Blu Tapas Bar
description: Right on the rocks at The Point! Enjoy tapas, cocktails, and pizzas while the ocean waves literally crash against the rocks below the deck.

name: The Jackal on the Beach
description: Housed in the historic Santos Pavilion right on the sand. Offers craft beer, great steaks, and sushi with unbeatable views of Santos Beach.

name: Carola Ann's
description: A healthy, Mediterranean-inspired cafe serving arguably the most beautifully plated breakfasts and lunches in town. Great coffee and vegan-friendly options.

name: Route 57 Restaurant
description: Co-owned by local golfing legend Louis Oosthuizen, Route 57 offers a premium dining experience with a menu featuring traditional South African flavors elevated with a modern twist.

name: The Kingfisher Restaurant
description: A beloved local spot famous for its fresh seafood, excellent sushi, and panoramic views of the bay. Perfect for a relaxed lunch or dinner by the sea.

name: Stars Restaurant & Sports Bar
description: A vibrant venue offering hearty meals, fantastic pizzas, and a great atmosphere to catch live sports on the big screens with a cold drink.

name: Piza e Vino Mossel Bay
description: Authentic wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas and fresh pastas served right on the water's edge at The Point. Fantastic cocktails and a vibrant sunset atmosphere.

name: Jakkalsvlei Private Cellar
description: A stunning, modern wine estate nestled in the mountains just outside Mossel Bay. Enjoy incredible wine pairings, wood-fired pizzas, and gourmet cheese platters on the rolling lawns.

name: Transkaroo Restaurant
description: Housed in the old Great Brak railway station. An upscale dining experience focusing on elevated South African cuisine—their slow-roasted lamb neck is legendary.

name: The Merchant Coffee
description: A trendy, minimalist specialty coffee shop focusing on micro-lot roasts, incredible pastries, and fast, free Wi-Fi for remote workers.

name: Salty River Beerhouse
description: A brilliant local craft beer hub offering a massive selection of local brews on tap, epic smash burgers, and live music on weekends.

name: Bahia Bleu Restaurant
description: Situated inside the Diaz Hotel right on the beach, offering a massive buffet breakfast, fine dining dinners, and cocktails overlooking the waves.

name: Peperboom Restaurant
description: A highly-rated daytime spot in the heart of Great Brak known for massive, delicious cakes, traditional breakfasts, and friendly small-town service.

name: Ponto Grille and Carvery
description: Authentic Portuguese cuisine and spectacular seafood platters. Their peri-peri chicken and espetadas are famous along the entire Garden Route.

name: Vista e Mar
description: A hidden gem offering quiet, relaxed dining with Portuguese flair. Excellent trinchado, calamari, and panoramic views of the entire bay area from the balcony.

name: Carpe Diem
description: A very popular breakfast and lunch spot for locals in Hartenbos. Big portions, excellent coffee, and a safe play area for the kids.

name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
description: Situated directly next to the St Blaize Lighthouse. Offers upscale seafood and grills with 180-degree ocean views. A fantastic spot for whale watching during dinner.

name: Cafe Havana
description: The center of Mossel Bay's nightlife! A Cuban-themed cigar lounge and bar offering excellent cocktails, late-night pizzas, and a great party atmosphere.

name: Searles Village Restaurant
description: A uniquely eclectic dining experience in Great Brak. Dine among vintage cars and antiques while enjoying hearty South African pub fare and wood-fired pizzas.

name: Biesies Jetty Restaurant
description: A very casual, barefoot-on-the-beach setup. Known for serving some of the best fresh fish and chips in Mossel Bay in a totally unpretentious setting.

name: ReedValley Restaurant
description: Beyond their events, the daily restaurant serves massive Portuguese Espetadas and traditional pasteis de nata that pair perfectly with their export-quality wines.
